name: RevenueCat
description: RevenueCat lets agents read and change the setup of your in-app subscriptions: apps, products, entitlements, offerings, packages, paywalls and experiments. Agents can also look up customers and their purchases, and read charts and metrics. A RevenueCat secret API key goes into one Authorization header. The key reaches one project. With a read-only key, agents can only read. With a write key, agents can submit products to the App Store for review, grant entitlements to customers, and delete packages, targeting rules and webhooks.

prompts.text: Which offerings and packages does my RevenueCat project have?
How did my RevenueCat revenue and active subscriptions change this month?
Which entitlements does this RevenueCat customer have, and when do they expire?

apps.name: RevenueCat
apps.description: Products, entitlements, offerings, paywalls and metrics, over RevenueCat's MCP server with a secret API key.

fields.label: API key
fields.hint: In the RevenueCat dashboard, open API keys in your project and create a secret API key. A read-only key is enough to view data.
